create.name: Christian Thomas
create.bio:
Christian Thomas is a guided meditation creator from Gloucestershire in the west of England, best known as the voice behind Meditation Vacation. He started uploading guided meditations to YouTube in March 2015, and the channel has since become one of the larger meditation channels on the platform. He came to meditation during a difficult stretch of his own life and found it gave him a way back to himself, and that is the spirit in which he records: practices that turn attention inward so each listener can find their own direction.

Most of his work is made for the night. He is known for very long talk-downs, some running for three hours or more, that move from a slow body scan into a spoken journey through a forest, along a beach or aboard a train, with a gentle soundscape underneath. Lucid dreaming is a second strand, with guided journeys meant to carry you into sleep while keeping a thread of awareness into the dream itself. His catalogue also takes in affirmations, spirit guide and past-life journeys, and chakra and morning practices. The recordings are on Insight Timer, YouTube and the main streaming services, in a members' area on his website, and as single downloads.

courses.title: Meditation Vacation Membership
courses.description: A subscription that unlocks more than a hundred of Christian's meditations to stream on his website without adverts, with new recordings added over time. It comes as a monthly or yearly plan with a seven-day free trial and can be cancelled at any time.
courses.price: £2.99 GBP a month or £29.99 GBP a year

courses.title: 7 Sleep Meditations
courses.description: A bundle of seven of Christian's sleep meditations to download and keep, for listening offline at bedtime.

courses.title: Lucid dreaming meditation to meet your spirit guide
courses.description: A single guided recording to buy and download that pairs his lucid dreaming approach with a journey to meet a spirit guide as you drift off.

courses.title: Spirit Guide Meditation
courses.description: A downloadable guided meditation from his store for connecting with a spirit guide.

courses.title: Live An Authentic Life
courses.description: A downloadable guided meditation on living as yourself, in keeping with his wider theme of finding your own path.

free_resources.title: Christian Thomas on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Christian's long sleep journeys, lucid dreaming meditations, affirmations and seasonal sleepscapes such as winter train rides. Free to hear in the app or on the web.

flags: His own descriptions are condition-framed: the Insight Timer bio says he makes meditations for anxiety, depression and insomnia, and the YouTube about text mentions anxiety relief and falling asleep faster. Most YouTube titles are sleep and lucid dreaming (allowed), so a plan was written; the owner may still judge the brand as condition-led.
Email contact@meditationvacation.co.uk is the Meditation Vacation brand inbox (named owner contact in the site's privacy policy).
YouTube channel, Facebook page and website trade as 'Meditation Vacation'; counted as his own because he is the only voice and owner.
TikTok @meditationvacation (nickname Christian Thomas) counted but not linked: not linked from his site.

Photo identity: the website photo and the Insight Timer photo look like the same man but with different hair; the website image is not captioned, only placed under 'Journey to Inner Peace with Christian'.
Store download descriptions are generic because the product pages give only a title and price.
Overthinking-titled videos and products left out as borderline.

Store items in Pain Relief, Healing and anxiety categories (e.g. 'Anxiety & Worry Relief', 'Overthinking Relief And Healing Before Sleep').
